name: glute-kickback-cable-one-leg
title: Glute Kickback: Cable (One Leg)
primer: This is an exercise for glutes and hamstring strengthening.
steps: Standing at a cable tower attach an ankle cuff to a low pulley.
Face the weight stack with a slight bend in your knees and your abs drawn in.
Slowly kick your ankle back in an arc as high as you are able to.
Return to the starting position and switch ankles.
